subject: Designer / Draftsperson (South Melbourne): Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello Entire hiring team,

I am applying for the Designer / Draftsperson role in your Fire Protection team in South Melbourne, advertised on SEEK (job 95137066).

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026 with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and I also used Revit for a pedestrian Warren truss bridge model in that course. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project in charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa.

Your advert says fire protection experience is not required if the candidate brings Revit and AutoCAD and a sharp eye for detail. My Revit and AutoCAD are from study rather than production fire drafting, and I am ready to learn your standards on the job.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
